stem: The diagram shows three squares that are joined at vertices to form a right triangle.

options.label: A
options.text: The sum of the areas of Square N and Square L is equal to the area of Square K.

options.label: B
options.text: The sum of the areas of Square N and Square L is greater than the area of Square K.

options.label: C
options.text: The sum of the areas of Square N and Square K is equal to the area of Square L.

options.label: D
options.text: The sum of the areas of Square N and Square K is less than the area of Square L.

visual_elements: Diagram of three squares labeled N, K, and L arranged to form a right triangle with a shaded right angle between squares N and L.
